172001.Title: Thirsty Villager's Recollection
172001.Description:
We had enjoyed many years of peaceful living here
before those monsters cut off our access to the nearby watering hole
and with it the lifeblood of the village.
Many thanks to the Divine Light and Priestess Belinda for driving away the evil!
Even if our well has been corrupted,
she has given us a beacon of hope in the restoration of our village!

172002.Title: Forest Guard's Recollection.
172002.Description:
How I do love these woods beyond measure!
If only they were not currently subject to so much evil—Black Mist and Hypogeans.
Thank heavens the Priestess of the Light Belinda has driven them away!
Perhaps our woods can return to its former glory.
Oh Divine Light, please grant Belinda smooth passage!

172003.Title: Lost Girl's Recollection
172003.Description:
Belinda saved me!
I'm so happy she came!
I'll pray for her every day...
Oh Divine Light, please always watch over Belinda!

514001.Description:
After fighting bears and falling into the trap, Hunter Tasi is too weak to overcome the wolf.
Tasi loses consciousness only to find herself in another body when she wakes up.

514002.Description:
The wolf disguised as Grandma reveals its true self with its jaws opening wide...
Tasi loses consciousness only to find herself in another body when she wakes up.

306001.Description:
Soon after...
Miss Lotti formally inherits the manor
and continues to run the town.
As time goes on...
the town continues to prosper,
but the ownership of the manor passes to a young man.
The townsfolk say
that he's Lady Lina's illegitimate child
from overseas
and he got rid of Miss Lotti.
As for Detective Purrrlock,
no one has seen or heard from her
for many years.

306002.Description:
Detective Purrrlock sets fire to the goldflare garden
and leaves town.
As time goes on...
people hear that the mercenary group has degenerated into in-fighting.
Some mercenaries come to town
but leave empty-handed.
Without the manor's support,
the town falls into ruin.
Some townsfolk pass away
while others leave.
However...
all around the town,
goldflare flowers start to sprout.
As for Detective Purrrlock,
no one has seen or heard from her
for many years.

306003.Description:
Detective Purrrlock leaves town.
Miss Lotti formally inherits the manor
and continues to run the town.
As time goes on...
Miss Lotti falls ill.
Detective Purrrlock once again returns to the manor
and becomes the new lady of the residence.
The relationship between Detective Purrrlock and Miss Lotti
is the subject of much gossip...
The goldflares continue to bring wealth
and prosperity to the town.

603001.Title: Wonderful News
603001.Description:
Robin Hood eliminated the local bandits,
thus helping the mother to find her daughter.
This is wonderful news indeed.
Right up until he left the manor,
the farmer lady protested so much,
that Robin Hood never even laid eyes on the little girl.
No one could ignore Lord Beckett's wealth.
Before long, more bandits came
and attacked the manor.
With the Account Book back in his possession, Lord Beckett's hands were no longer tied.
He wasted no time and hired a strong team of mercenaries
and had the bandit camp burned to the ground.

603002.Title: New Tomorrow
603002.Description:
The manor's secrets were revealed
and as promised,
little Jasmine often wrote to Robin Hood.
She told him that her brother had already become lord of the manor
and that he kept the manor safe from nearby bandits.
She also said that when she grew up, she wanted to be like Robin Hood.
She wanted to be someone who upheld truth and justice.

603003.Title: Rebellious Child
603003.Description:
Robin Hood brought the daughter back to her mother.
This is wonderful news indeed.
But not long after
the mother wrote to him once more saying that her rebellious daughter had run off again.
The bandits had used the account book to blackmail Lord Beckett out of most of his money before disappearing.
Robin Hood shook his head and sighed.
He resolved to not get involved again.
He hoped that the little girl would end up okay.
As for Lord Beckett,
it seems that his account book was full of secrets,
and he got what was coming to him.

287001.Title: The Forsaken Family
287001.Description:
Daimon had so much fun
at the Noctis Animarum Festival today.
He remembered those celebrations many years ago,
spent together with his mom.
The taste of Blueberry Mix hasn't changed,
just like her love for Daimon.
They had been separated before,
but she had always fought to find him and bring them back together.
Now, they will never be apart again.

287002.Title: The Forsaken Family
287002.Description:
Daimon had so much fun
at the Noctis Animarum Festival today.
What filled his heart with joy the most was seeing his mom's smile once again.
They had been separated before,
but she had always fought to find him and bring them back together.
Now, they will never be apart again.

287003.Title: The Forsaken Family
287003.Description:
Daimon had so much fun
at the Noctis Animarum Festival today.
But occasionally, his mother furrowed her brow, as if something didn't feel right.
Daimon was puzzled, yet his mother never say a word.
They had been separated before,
but she had always fought to find him and bring them back together.
Now, they will never be apart again.

604001.Title: Lingering Fear
604001.Description:
After an arduous battle,
Soul Singer and his friends finally defeated the Hypogean.
But they remain on edge,
unsure if there may be another victim.
Renowned musicians,
stay vigilant at all times.
If your talent falls short of your reputation,
a Hypogean awaits you in the academy
.

4011001.Title: Ambush
4011001.Description:
A sudden attack scattered the group.
Soon, Estrilda realized that Mira had disappeared.

4011002.Title: The Other Side
4011002.Description:
Meanwhile, on the other side,
Mira anxiously called out to her companions...

40127001.Description:
Under the guidance of Dreaf, the "grunts" finally overthrew their oppressive leaders.
They held a grand party to celebrate their hard-earned victory.
Meanwhile, far away on the other side,
The mastermind behind the company, the Molten Crystalline Worm Queen, was fleeing with her hoarded wealth.
But just as she was plotting her revenge,
a portal slowly opened before her...

40123001.Title: Unforeseen Storms
40123001.Description: Dreaf's been dragged into the Reflection Room...

610001.Title: Employment Contract
610001.Description:
To our future "Model Monster Employee",
Congratulations on joining Infernal Enterprises!
Below is a carefully prepared employment agreement. Please read carefully and sign.
Once signed, the contract takes immediate effect. Any breach will result in disciplinary action from the Education & Development Center.

610002.Title: Employment Contract
610002.Description:
Clause 1: Working Hours
We adopt a flexible working schedule: Your start time is NOT flexible (you must clock in on time or face fines). Your end time, however, is infinitely flexible (you may leave once your supervisor is satisfied).

610003.Title: Employment Contract
610003.Description:
Clause 2: Meal Benefits
If you work overtime past 10 PM, you may receive Lord Mezoth's leftover meal. If no leftovers are available, you will be awarded a Magma Brew (freshness not guaranteed).

610004.Title: Employment Contract
610004.Description:
Clause 3: Performance Rewards
The top three winners of the "Never Goes Home" Award each month will receive a prestigious "Hypogean Workaholic" Trophy and a "Hell Never Sleeps" Badge, personally signed by the CEO.

610005.Title: Employment Contract
610005.Description:
Clause 4: Midday Benefits
During lunch breaks, live Hell Metal performances by Lavatune will be provided, ensuring maximum wakefulness and zero drowsiness!

610006.Title: Employment Contract
610006.Description:
Clause 5: Corporate Culture
Our company follows a "Wolf Pack" culture: survival of the fittest, and no mercy for the weak. Employees must compete fiercely (without harming company interests). The bottom performers each quarter will receive a special "performance re-education" session led by the Earl, head of the HR Department.

610007.Title: Employment Contract
610007.Description:
Clause 6: Additional Terms
Employees must strictly adhere to the company's confidentiality agreement. Anyone caught secretly reading or copying the Earl's classified documents will be detained in the isolation chamber for interrogation.

523001.Description: Laios crouches down on all fours and starts moving slowly, imitating the posture of a spider larva. When he accidentally steps on his fingers, he doesn't flinch. Instead, he tightens his back muscles and starts swaying his body to a strange rhythm.

523002.Description: The monster crisis in the town has been resolved. With the help of the dungeon adventurers, the chef's restaurant is back in business. On the opening day, a banner handwritten by the chef reading "New Menu - Monster Cuisine Tasting Event" hangs above the signboard. The restaurant is packed with people, and the air is filled with the enticing aroma of food. Laios and his party arrive at the restaurant to attend the event.

4013001.Title: Perilous Waters
4013001.Description:
The summer feast is about to begin.
This year, you and Alvida are in charge of the most important dish on the menu.
Just as you're struggling to decide on a main ingredient...
A thunderous roar rises from the sea—a sea monster appears!

4013002.Title: To Each Their Own
4013002.Description:
After some chatting, everyone heads back to their camps on different parts of the island.
Now, it's time to go talk to Captain Alvida about the sudden disappearance of Tidus.

4013003.Title: Celebrating As One
4013003.Description:
Pippa and Raku have found the perfect shell.
Now they can cheerfully return to camp, ready for the next leg of the adventure.
It's time to head out for Day 2 of the hunt!

4013004.Title: Treasure Hunt Team
4013004.Description:
After a short while, Mira comes bouncing over.
Thane and Baden hurry behind her, clearly flustered.

4013005.Title: The Note
4013005.Description:
"Where waves crash and the land lies wide,
No hill, no tree, no place to bide.
At center sleeps a silent prize—
Only the bold and wise shall rise."

4013006.Title: The Note
4013006.Description:
"When twilight falls and light departs,
A thread of dreams tugs at our hearts.
By sunset's glow and wooden beam,
A lone tree waits beside the stream."

4013007.Title: Crisis Averted
4013007.Description:
Although Mehira's true intentions are still unclear, the immediate danger seems to have passed.
Head out for today's hunt.

526001.Description:
In a shadowy corner of Esperia, a band of zealous labyrinth designers devote their lives crafting elaborate labyrinths meant to stop adventurers in their tracks. They call these creations "Wonders."
But clever challengers always find a way through. So the designers resolved to create one final, ultimate "Wonder."
Now, the labyrinth is nearing completion...

526003.Description: On the far side of the labyrinth—

6001001.Description:
Demonic power awakened deep within the abyss,
Then swept across Esperia in relentless waves.
Villages, forests, and even cities fell into chaos,
The entire continent teetering on the brink...
